Product Features

  • The high-quality Corduroy fabric feels particularly soft, is skin-friendly and durable at the same time. The fine surface provides an elegant look and creates a warm, cosy atmosphere – ideal for everyday use in the living room or reception area.
  • The spacious 2-seater sofa offers enough space for couples or small households. The matching stool flexibly expands the seating and lying surface and allows you to put your legs up in a relaxed manner - perfect for shared moments of rest and leisure.
  • The extra-wide seat is ergonomically designed and supports a natural sitting posture. The back and legs are optimally relieved, so that even prolonged sitting, reading or watching TV remains pleasant and fatigue-free.
  • The extra thick seat cushions are filled with high-density foam and offer a good balance of softness and stability. They retain their shape even with regular use and ensure a high level of seating comfort over the long term.
  • The combination of solid foam and flake foam ensures optimal pressure distribution and pleasant elasticity. This construction noticeably increases comfort and prevents you from sitting through quickly - ideal for everyday use.
  • The integrated USB-C port allows you to conveniently charge your smartphone or tablet directly from your sofa. Practical side pockets offer space for remote control, books or magazines and keep everything close at hand.
  • The robust plastic feet ensure a secure stand and protect the floor from scratches. They are durable, easy to care for and ensure a high level of stability – even when used daily by several people.
  • The modular units can be flexibly adapted to your living situation – whether as a large corner sofa, L-shape or individual seating modules. You design your sofa according to your needs and room size.
